metadata.primary_purpose: type-specific independently modelled policy coverage signal, not actual legal/noncompliance/safety
metadata.approximate_geometry: equirectangular 111195m latitude and 111320*cos(37.5deg) longitude, 5m midpoint sample for OSM polyline
metadata.facility_points: 15 child 4 elderly from 2025-05-27 police Dongjak-only dataset; no disability facility records
metadata.zone_polygons: 2025-05-27 police geometries filtered by exact facility_type; 18 polygons
metadata.source_road_geometry: shared OSM network geometry only; excludes lighting/accident/width/slope data
metadata.formula: per 5m point: if inside same-type registered zone 100 else min(100, same-type nearest facility point straight-line distance in m/5); weighted mean per segment; gap_strength=100-policy_coverage
metadata.school_assignments: 2026-09-20 official SHP overlap ONLY context, no score effect
